verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a reasonable thing to ask of a 2FA app and API product, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows mobile and desktop apps, a web-language SDK and the Authy API, which Twilio says is now closed to new customers. The only command-line-style tooling mentioned is a third-party GitHub project (alexzorin/authy), which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
